dogecoin.text: If you’re smart with your #dogecoin then today should have been a great day for you to sell high and buy low.  Increasing our share totals is the best thing #dogecoin420 has given us.
Play it smart and know when to sell and buy.  Don't use an app like Robinhood to play with your money.  Break out the laptop and chart your strategies.  #dogecoin #doge420 https://t.co/xYxwVlHgE0

To panic sell on a major dip will only cause your total shares to decrease, which is the most important aspect of trading.  Hold on dips and try to buy more.  Sell between 5-20% during stable peak periods and buy back on the dip.  Increase your share total!  #dogecoin
